description_html:
Die noris network AG steht für innovative, sichere und nachhaltige IT-Lösungen. Mit über 600 engagierten Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir leistungsstarke Services in den Bereichen Cloud, Datacenter, Network & Security sowie Managed Applications – betrieben auf einer hochmodernen, mehrfach zertifizierten IT-Infrastruktur mit eigenen Hochsicherheitsrechenzentren. Seit 1993 sind wir kontinuierlich gewachsen und zählen heute zu den führenden IT-Spezialisten in Deutschland. Unser größtes Kapital? Ein starkes, diverses Team mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel: die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mitzugestalten. Deshalb fördern wir Eigenverantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und frische Ideen – in einem Umfeld, das Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit vereint.

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb Dich an unseren Standorten in Nürnberg, Aschheim, Berlin oder remote (innerhalb Deutschlands).

Unser Team Product & Solution Design entwickelt und dokumentiert die technischen Konzepte für die Implementierung und die nachfolgende Integration von Lösungen und Produkten (Services) in den Betrieb und berät die Kunden in Bezug auf Designfragen ihrer IT-Landschaft.

Aufgaben

  • Steuerung der technischen Entwicklung von Produkten (IT-Services) auf der Plattform- und Applikationsebene
  • Sehr enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement im Rahmen von Angebotsprozessen
  • Strukturierte Einbindung der fachspezifischen Technik-Teams und Systemarchitekten sowie externer Partner
  • Mitarbeit bei der technologischen Weiterentwicklung zentraler Betriebsplattformen
  • Technische Beratung von Kunden (branchenübergreifend) zu Lösungsplattformen
  • Erstellung von Design Guides und Blueprints sowie Coaching von KollegInnen zu technologischen Fragen

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Weitreichende Erfahrung in der technischen Umsetzung von IT-Projekten und im IT-Betrieb
  • Erfahrung in der praktischen Anwendung von mehreren Technologien
  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von rechenzentrumsnahen IT-Services, hohe Kundenorientierung und Qualitätsbewusstsein
  • Zielorientierung und kreative Lösungskompetenz sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Repräsentationsfähigkeit
  • Selbstständige, eigenverantwortliche und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Teamfähigkeit und unternehmerisches Handeln
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Arbeiten an verschiedenen Standorten möglich (z.B. Nürnberg, Aschheim, Berlin) oder auch zu 100% Remote
  • Hochwertiges Equipment: Laptop und Firmenhandy auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Individuelle Förderung und Weiterentwicklung durch Inhouse-Trainings und externe Schulungen
  • Kinderbetreuungskostenzuschuss (pro Monat/Kind) und Corporate Benefits
  • Attraktive Firmenevents (inkl. Reisekostenübernahme), kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie Duz-Kultur ab dem ersten Tag
  • Großzügiger Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket
  • Gesundheitsmanagement (z.B. kostenlose Massagen inhouse), Jobrad Leasing und betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Zuschuss
  • Welcome Day, direkter Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) und strukturierte Einarbeitungsphase
  • Getränke for free (auch Softdrinks) und frisches Obst an den Standorten

title: Director, Integrated Marketing (R-19922)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Dun & Bradstreet
description_html:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet
At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at dnb.com/careers.

The Director, Integrated Marketing is a critical leadership role responsible for driving marketing strategy and business growth across key global markets and business segments. You'll lead integrated marketing programs that build brand awareness, generate demand, and deliver measurable impact on pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition, and retention.

Working closely with senior leaders across the business, you'll translate market opportunities and commercial priorities into innovative, customer-focused marketing initiatives. You'll oversee marketing performance and investment decisions, champion data-driven decision-making, and help shape the future direction of the business.

As a people leader, you'll inspire and develop a high-performing team while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. This is an opportunity to influence strategy at a senior level and make a significant impact on both marketing performance and overall business success.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Define and lead the integrated marketing strategy and long-term roadmap, ensuring alignment with business growth objectives and market opportunities.
  • Act as a strategic partner to senior business leaders, providing guidance on customer engagement, market trends, and growth opportunities.
  • Develop and execute marketing plans across multiple business units, industries, and international markets.
  • Set annual and quarterly marketing priorities that support business goals and go-to-market strategies.
  • Leverage customer insights, market intelligence, and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform strategic decisions.
  • Drive measurable business impact through marketing, including pipeline growth, customer acquisition, revenue contribution, and brand engagement.
  • Establish and monitor key performance metrics to evaluate marketing effectiveness and optimize return on investment.
  • Translate performance data and market insights into clear recommendations for business stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Manage and optimize marketing investments across channels, programs, regions, and strategic initiatives.
  • Lead the development and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns across digital, content, communications, events, media, analyst relations, and field marketing.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to successfully launch new products, solutions, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Create seamless and consistent customer experiences across the entire customer journey.
  • Foster strong cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment between marketing, sales, product, and commercial teams.
  • Champion innovative marketing approaches, technologies, and customer engagement strategies to enhance performance and customer impact.
  • Lead planning and prioritization across global marketing teams to maximize business outcomes and execution excellence.
  • Influence strategic business decisions through data-driven insights, market intelligence, and compelling business cases.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of marketing professionals, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

    • About you:
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including senior leadership roles with responsibility for integrated marketing, demand generation, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing marketing teams in complex, fast-paced environments.
  • Experience shaping and executing global marketing strategies that drive business growth and support strategic priorities.
  • Demonstrated success delivering measurable business outcomes, including pipeline growth, revenue contribution, customer acquisition, and market expansion.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and partner effectively with senior leaders.
  • Deep expertise in integrated marketing, customer engagement, brand development, and multi-channel demand generation.
  • Hands-on experience with modern marketing technologies and analytics platforms, including Eloqua, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Proven ability to design and deliver integrated campaigns across digital, paid, earned, and owned channels that drive awareness, engagement, and commercial results.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to make informed decisions, prioritize investments, and maximize marketing impact and return on investment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and other business productivity tools.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, with a natural curiosity and a passion for driving continuous improvement and business success.
  • A collaborative leadership style, with the ability to build strong relationships across teams, functions, and geographies.
  • A commitment to continuous learning and professional growth, with a desire to stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving customer needs.
  • Interest in leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance marketing effectiveness, customer engagement, and team performance.

description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Analytics Account Executive based in United Kingdom.

This is a strategic sales role focused on accelerating growth across analytics, AI, and modern data platform solutions.
You will partner closely with enterprise Account Executives to identify opportunities, advance complex deals, and expand customer relationships.
The role combines deep expertise in analytics and AI with hands-on enterprise sales execution and consultative selling.
You will create new pipeline within existing accounts while helping sales teams position solutions around customer business priorities.
As a specialist overlay, you will influence multiple accounts and stakeholders while bringing strong domain expertise to the wider sales organisation.
You will engage senior technology and business leaders, navigate complex buying processes, and help customers modernize their data environments.
This is an opportunity to play a visible role in expanding adoption of data and AI technologies within a collaborative, high-performance EMEA sales environment.


Accountabilities
  • Partner with Account Executives and territory owners to accelerate active enterprise opportunities involving analytics, AI, data platforms, and related solutions.
  • Co-sell on complex opportunities, providing specialist domain expertise, customer insights, value propositions, and sales support throughout the deal cycle.
  • Design and execute targeted sales campaigns within existing customer accounts to uncover new analytics and AI opportunities and expand the commercial footprint.
  • Generate new pipeline proactively rather than relying solely on inbound opportunities.
  • Identify customer needs and connect analytics, AI, data modernization, cloud, and platform capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for the broader sales organisation, providing current analytics messaging, competitive positioning, industry insights, and value propositions.
  • Enable Account Executives and other field teams to confidently position analytics and AI solutions with enterprise customers.
  • Work closely with account owners to integrate specialist solutions into broader account plans and territory strategies.
  • Engage credibly with senior technology and business executives, helping them understand the strategic and commercial value of modern data and AI capabilities.
  • Lead discovery, qualification, negotiation, forecasting, and closing activities for opportunities within your specialist area.
  • Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies, including MEDDIC, to qualify opportunities and progress complex buying processes.
  • Build strong relationships across multiple accounts and sales teams while influencing outcomes without directly owning the overall account relationship.
  • Maintain strong commercial ownership, urgency, accountability, and focus throughout the sales cycle.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with relevant sales, technical, and business teams to improve deal execution and customer outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    • Proven track record of exceeding sales quotas in enterprise technology environments.
    • Demonstrated experience selling analytics, AI, data platforms, cloud, databases, data modernization, or closely related enterprise technology solutions.
    • Strong consultative and value-based selling capabilities, with experience applying MEDDIC or comparable structured sales methodologies to complex enterprise deals.
    • Demonstrated ability to create and develop pipeline proactively within existing accounts.
    • Experience selling complex technology solutions to enterprise customers with multiple stakeholders and extended buying cycles.
    • Strong understanding of analytics, AI, modern data platforms, data modernization, cloud technologies, or related enterprise technology domains.
    • Ability to engage confidently and credibly with senior technology and business executives and translate technical capabilities into business value.
    • Strong discovery, qualification, negotiation, forecasting, and closing skills.
    • Ability to operate effectively as a specialist overlay across multiple Account Executives, territories, and customer accounts.
    • Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to drive outcomes without directly owning the broader customer relationship.
    • High level of commercial ownership, urgency, accountability, and resilience.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving environment where strategic thinking and hands-on sales execution are equally important.
    • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.
    • A customer-focused mindset and genuine interest in helping organisations use data and AI to modernize their technology environments.

      • Benefits:

      • Comprehensive employee wellbeing and wellness resources.
      • Access to health and wellness support and guidance through a dedicated wellbeing programme.
      • Wellness-focused initiatives, including Wellness Fridays.
      • Region-specific benefits tailored to the local employment market.
      • Remote working flexibility.
      • Inclusive and collaborative international working environment.
      • Opportunities to work with enterprise customers on analytics, AI, cloud, and modern data transformation initiatives.
      • Support for employee wellbeing and work-life balance.

title: Senior Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Userlane
description_html:
About Userlane

Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally.

Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications.


Your mission

Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as:

  • Defining metrics that hold up: Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete.

  • Delivering outcome-linked metrics: Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on

  • Building for time-poor executives: Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?"

  • Connecting fragmented data sources: Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems,

  • Transforming insights into action: Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once

  • AI adoption governance: Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation

  • You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't.

  • You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?"

  • You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does.

  • You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight

  • You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus

  • You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product

  • You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike

  • You're fluent in English (spoken and written)


What's in for you

  • Team & Culture: A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries

  • Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems

  • Product strategy influence: Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors

  • Market: Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry

  • Growth: We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training
    Benefits: We offer flexible benefits related to savings and security, health and well-being, and lifestyle and leisure

description_html:
About the role

We're looking for two Payment Support Coordinators to join our Expert Services & Operations (ES&O) team on a short-term contract basis. You'll work directly on our linguist payment queue, helping to clear a backlog of payment requests and restoring a reliable, responsive experience for our global network of expert linguists.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You'll be triaging, investigating, and resolving payment issues across multiple systems, working closely with our existing coordinators and escalating to finance and engineering where needed.

What you'll be doing

  • Triaging and responding to incoming payment support tickets in Jira, prioritising by urgency and issue type

  • Investigating payment failures, discrepancies, and delays across the Lilt platform, Tipalti, Salesforce, and third-party processors (PayPal, Payoneer)

  • Resolving common issues including: Tipalti profile corrections, 2FA resets, banking detail mismatches, and manual offline payment (OPM) re-logging

  • Communicating clearly and empathetically with linguists to gather information and provide timely updates

  • Escalating technical breakages (e.g. platform stats sync issues) and rate discrepancies to the relevant internal teams

  • Maintaining accurate ticket notes and contributing to weekly reporting on queue volume and SLA adherence

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a payments, finance operations, or customer/vendor support role

  • Comfortable working across multiple systems simultaneously (Jira, Salesforce, or similar)

  • Detail-oriented with strong written communication skills — you'll be dealing with complex, sometimes sensitive payment disputes

  • Able to work independently, manage a high-volume queue, and know when to escalate

  • Experience with Tipalti or international payment platforms is a strong plus

  • Fluency in English required; additional languages are a bonus given our global linguist community

What to expect

This is a contract role. You'll be joining a small, collaborative ES&O team and will have clear ownership of a defined portion of the queue from day one.

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Airwallex
description_html:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

We’re building Airwallex’s DACH Enterprise team from the ground up - and we need a founding member to set the pace.

This is a rare, high-impact opportunity to help lay the foundation for our next era of growth. You won't just follow a playbook; you’ll write it. As one of our first Enterprise hires in the region, you’ll directly shape our DACH go-to-market strategy, own high-stakes territory, and secure the flagship enterprise deals that put Airwallex at the very top of the market.

If you thrive in greenfield environments and want your footprint on a market-defining motion, this is your launchpad.

What you’ll do

As an Account Manager on the Enterprise team, you will manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and help them maximise Airwallex value. You will build trusted relationships across commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, while identifying opportunities to increase adoption, retain customers and expand their use of Airwallex’s products and markets. You will combine strategic account planning with hands-on ownership of upsells, escalations, onboarding and complex customer initiatives. Working cross-functionally, you will turn customer insights into action and contribute to the growth of Airwallex’s Enterprise Business. This role is a quota-carrying commercial role and is based in Munich, Germany.

Responsibilities:

  • Grow gross profit from existing customer accounts, manage customer operational success, and pursue upsell and expansion opportunities across Airwallex’s product suite.

  • Build and execute strategic account plans, including customer objectives, stakeholder maps, risks, renewal plans and 12 to 18-month growth opportunities.

  • Lead renewals, commercial negotiations, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, using data and customer insight to improve retention and drive Net Revenue Retention.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and run effective business reviews that demonstrate value, address risks and align on future priorities.

  • Coordinate complex customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts, while sharing customer feedback that can inform product, operational and go-to-market improvements.

Who you are

Minimum qualifications:

  • 8+ years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions.

  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders.

  • Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally.

  • Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage.

  • Native German and English fluency required

  • Hybrid work model: 3 days per week in-office

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products.

  • Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders.

  • A data-driven approach to account health, forecasting, renewal planning and commercial prioritisation, with strong CRM discipline.

  • Curiosity, resilience and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment, adapt to evolving priorities and proactively solve complex customer problems.

Why Join Us

  • Build the future of global finance with one of the world’s fastest-growing, most innovative fintechs

  • Work alongside exceptional, ambitious teammates on a truly global platform

  • Accelerate your career: as an early enterprise hire, you’ll have significant scope to move into team leadership as the motion scales

  • Earn a competitive base salary, commission, and valuable equity in an $11B company on a clear path to IPO

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer

description_html:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, which make up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

You will be our first full-time Frontend Engineer and set the technical direction for the entire frontend codebase and architecture.You will build a basis upon which all other team members can do high-quality frontend contributions, at scale. You will leverage your experience in web development to teach and mentor your peers, becoming the go-to person for all frontend-related topics. You will bring perspective how agentic user interfaces will influence web development, and act as the key player in building towards this future.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll own the full product loop; discovery conversations, forming hypotheses, shipping, and measuring. You will partner with our ‘Product Design’ team to evolve our design system, utilising your strong understanding of what makes up great design and UX.

In the first 6 months, you will

  • Ownership: Take full ownership over complex, ambiguous projects: define requirements, navigate trade-offs, and drive delivery. Specifically, building out the capabilities of “Emigo”, our home-grown AI assistant, and ship agentic user interfaces that transform how our customers get work done with Emidat.

  • Building: Prototype and develop new applications from zero to one that unlock new value for our customers.

  • Evangelism: Take technical ownership of our component library, including maintaining components and contributions, expanding documentation, and evangelizing its use across the team.

  • Mentorship: Coach other engineers on system architecture and web fundamentals, as well as help us invest in tooling, processes, and abstractions that multiply the team's output.

  • Problem Solving: Identify issues others don't see, and turn them into actionable proposals.

Our Tech Stack:

  • Languages: Python, TypeScript

  • Backend: FastAPI, gRPC

  • Frontend: React

  • Databases: PostgreSQL, Redis

  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Kubernetes, OpenTofu, OTel, AWS, Azure

  • CI/CD & Automation: GitHub Actions, Docker, FluxCD

  • Product Delivery: Linear

What you should bring to this role

Minimum requirements

  • Proven track record of owning and driving impactful product initiatives end-to-end, shaping frontend architecture and defining engineering standards in a ‘Senior / Staff’ level role.

  • Expertise in TypeScript with deep expertise in frameworks for creating scalable web applications like React (strongly preferred), Angular, Vue or Svelte.

  • Created, maintained, and contributed to design systems or component libraries.

  • Experience thriving in a fast-moving environment where priorities and direction can shift quickly, and is ready to pivot when the data points a new way. Ideally demonstrable from experience in a start-up or scale-up environment.

  • Experienced in leveraging AI to accelerate product development.

  • Fluent English (C1+).

Nice to haves

  • Domain knowledge or professional exposure to adjacent sectors, such as Climate/Sustainability, Construction Tech, or Manufacturing, or Compliance.

  • Experience having created agentic user interfaces.

  • Strong and demonstrable UI/UX judgement with good understanding of best practices and anti-patterns.

How we support you

Your Team Lead will be

  • Thomas (Tech Lead, New Applications)

You will work closely with

  • Florian (CTO & Co-Founder)

  • Alexander (Software Engineer)

  • Nicklas (Software Engineer)

  • Jona (Product Manager)

  • Lauren (Product Design Lead)

  • Tom (Tech Lead, Climate Intelligence)

  • Nils (Tech Lead, Digital Twin)

Your mentors can be

We have built up a strong network of supporters in the product and tech who want us to succeed with our software solution. You’ll have access to product and tech experts from day 1, amongst them

  • David Bellem (Co-Founder & prev. CTO @payworks)

  • Nino Ulsamer (Co-Founder & CTO @StashAway)

  • Renaud Visage (Co-Founder & prev. CTO @Eventbrite)

Meet the rest of the team HERE

See our full benefits HERE, including

  • 💸 Attractive compensation package including VSOP (for FTEs)

  • 🏖️ 25 days of vacation days per year

  • 📚 €2,000 Learning Budget

Admin

  • Role type: Full-Time

  • Location: Munich, Germany (open to Remote in Europe for strong candidates)

  • Office Requirement: Hybrid (Munich-based) or Remote.

  • Travel Required? No

  • Relocation: Preference will be given to candidates based in Muncih. However, we are open to strong remote candidates or those that need to relocate.

Compensation: €90K – €110K • €5K – €10K Equity

  • Software Engineer • €90K – €110K • €5K – €10K Equity

title: Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Black Semiconductor GmbH
description_html:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are looking for a Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert, to develop and refine physics based models for graphene photonic devices. Working at the intersection of research and software development you will translate state-of-the-art research into reliable simulation capabilities that support device design and development.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Research the literature on state-of-the-art approaches to graphene device modeling and simulation

  • Work with commercial TCAD and multiphysics simulation tools

  • Translate physical models from scientific literature into robust, maintainable Python code

  • Develop and extend models for graphene-based photonic devices, incorporating new physical effects and functionalities

  • Calibrate, validate, and refine models using experimental characterization data

  • Collaborate closely with various teams, prioritizing modeling activities in line with team and company goals

  • Document your work clearly and contribute to shared software-development practices

Your Qualifications

  • PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • Strong foundation in solid-state physics, semiconductor physics, and mathematics

  • Proficient in modeling techniques and methodologies for semiconductor physics

  • Proven ability to translate scientific literature and mathematical models into simulation code

  • Experience with TCAD development

  • Proficiency in Python and Git

  • Experience solving partial differential equations, particularly for charge and heat transport

  • Experience with graphene and photonics

  • Experience with commercial simulation tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or Ansys Lumerical is a plus

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

 

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

If your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. Read more about our privacy policy here.

title: Account Director
description_html:
Superside is hiring an Account Director to lead and grow a portfolio of strategically important enterprise customers. You’ll own the full customer lifecycle, from pre-sale scoping through delivery, renewal, and expansion, ensuring customers see Superside as a long-term creative partner.

This role sits at the intersection of customer strategy, commercial growth, and delivery. You’ll lead cross-functional teams, manage senior stakeholders, and drive retention, expansion, and high-quality delivery across complex accounts.

What you’ll do

  • Own the end-to-end relationship for 5–10 enterprise customers, driving retention, expansion, and executive trust.
  • Develop and execute account growth strategies, identifying upgrade and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead renewals and commercial negotiations in partnership with leadership.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and procurement teams.
  • Translate customer goals into scalable creative programs and solutions.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Producers to ensure seamless delivery across workstreams.
  • Act as the senior escalation point, resolving issues quickly and maintaining customer confidence.
  • Monitor account health, burn rates, and pacing to ensure performance and profitability.
  • Develop ROI-driven business cases that demonstrate the value of Superside’s model.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve customer outcomes.
  • Coach and develop PMs and Producers to raise the bar on delivery and customer management.
  • Partner with Creative, Product, and Operations to align on resourcing and execution.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 5–10+ years of experience in account management or client services in creative, marketing, or digital environments.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing enterprise or high-value global accounts.
  • 3–5+ years in an account leadership role (e.g., Senior Account Manager, Group Account Manager, or equivalent).
  • Strong commercial acumen with ownership of revenue, retention, and growth targets.
  • Experience working with enterprise, SaaS, D2C, or B2B clients.
  • Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders and navigate complex organizations.
  • Experience leading and developing cross-functional teams.
  • Strong operational mindset with the ability to scale delivery while maintaining quality.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into actionable programs and outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills with a structured, solution-oriented approach.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Sales Development Representative - API/CPaaS (NwPS)
description_html:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs: 

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more. 

Why this role matters: 

As a Sales Development Representative you will be responsible for creating, identifying, and qualifying new sales opportunities in the Network Powered Solutions vertical. You will be a key driver of Vonage's growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying new business opportunities within the Telecom Ecosystem (mobile network operators, virtual network operators, internet service providers, and regional service providers). 

You will be the very first point of contact a potential customer will have with Vonage API and play a vital role not only in generating sales pipeline, but helping us refine sales and marketing strategy based on your interactions and successes with prospects. 

There are tremendous growth opportunities within this position and team; you will have a chance to learn and develop skills on B2B technology sales and marketing and more. We are growing rapidly and we expect our SDRs to grow to more senior positions across the organization as we gain experience and achieve higher levels of performance. 

Your key responsibilities: 

  • Perform outbound prospecting activities, and contact potential clients through phone/video calls, emails, LinkedIn or other channels 
  • Discover new leads through creative internet research and social media monitoring/messaging, using LinkedIn Navigator and other sales tools 
  • Develop a deep understanding of the U.S. Network Powered Solutions market, including key players, buying cycles, technical terminology, and competitive dynamics 
  • Keep meticulous and detailed notes updated in our CRM system 
  • Articulate Vonage's API portfolio (SMS/messages, Voice, Video, Authentication) and the differentiated value it delivers to network operators and service providers 
  • Schedule qualified meetings and demos for our Account Managers 
  • Collaborate with marketing, account managers, and sales leadership to optimize performance 
  • Achieve monthly targets number of qualified Appointments & new sales Opportunities 
  • Develop and maintain territory plan with Account Managers from your assigned geography 
  • Have strong working product knowledge of Vonage’s API product suites 
  • Support Vonage API marketing efforts by assisting in online and other marketing campaigns 

What you’ll bring: 

Required: 

  • 2+ years of Sales Development / Lead generation and or sales experience in B2B environments, especially in the software industry 
  • Ability to speak and write in English at a professional level 
  • Strong Cold calling, Video-call and Personalized email creation experience 
  • Self Motivated and Self Organized: you take ownership of your territory and bring creative, research-driven thinking to every outreach. 
  • CRM and LinkedIn Experience required. You will be trained on our tech stack: Salesforce, Gong and Gong Engage, LinkedIn Sales Nav, ZoomInfo, Lusha and Gen AI tools. 
  • Outbound experience targeting network operators, wholesale carriers, and/or telecom providers 

Experience we consider a plus: 

  • Prior exposure to CPaaS, cloud communications, or API-based solutions 
  • Familiarity with A2P SMS, SIP trunking, or wholesale voice routing concepts 
  • Highly collaborative mindset who is a team player - our success is together, not alone. 
  • Ability to work at a fast pace to have as many meaningful interactions with prospects as possible each day 
  • Goal-oriented mindset 
  • Creativity around new ideas to help the team be successful 

Where you will work: 

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Mexico. 

Legal authorization to work in Mexico is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

How you’ll benefit: 

  • Medical Insurance 
  • Group Life Insurance 
  • Meal Card (Pluxee Tienda Card) 
  • Volunteer Time (VTO) 
  • Ericsson Care Line 
  • Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process. 

This is a salaried role and would be part of our Commission Compensation structure. The overall compensation would be based on a 70/30 split. #LI-ML1

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

title: Mitarbeiter in der Qualitätssicherung / Produktkontrolleure (m/w/d)

description_html:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Gudensberg suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Mitarbeiter in der Qualitätssicherung / Produktkontrolleure (m/w/d)

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

Unser Betrieb im hessischen Gudensberg spielt eine essenzielle Rolle bei der Produktion frischer Geflügelspezialitäten. Mit einer großen und innovativen Produktpalette versorgen wir von Gudensberg aus nicht nur den deutschen Lebensmitteleinzelhandel, sondern auch Großverbraucher und die Cateringbranche. Erstklassige Qualität steht für uns dabei immer im Mittelpunkt.

Deine Tätigkeiten: 

  • Du pflegst und optimierst unser HACCP-System sowie das bestehende Hygienekonzept, um höchste Sicherheitsstandards zu garantieren.

  • Du führst regelmäßige Probennahmen nach Plan durch und sorgst dafür, dass alle Vorgaben präzise eingehalten werden.

  • In enger Abstimmung mit dem Produktionsteam stellst du sicher, dass alle Fertigungsschritte den gesetzlichen, internen und kundenspezifischen Qualitätsvorgaben entsprechen.

  • Du übernimmst Mitverantwortung dafür, dass wir alle lebensmittelrechtlichen Anforderungen jederzeit sicher erfüllen.

  • Du stellst eine lückenlose Rückverfolgbarkeit entlang der gesamten Produktionskette sicher – vom Rohstoff bis zum fertigen Produkt.

  • Du überwachst die Einhaltung der Hygienevorschriften im Alltag und schulst deine Kollegen direkt vor Ort durch praxisnahe Unterweisungen.

  • Du führst alle qualitätssichernden Kontrollen während der laufenden Produktion durch und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Diese Qualifikationen solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Berufserfahrung aus der Lebensmittelindustrie mit und kennst die dortigen Abläufe.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, bist top organisiert und behältst durch deine strukturierte Art auch bei vielen Aufgaben den Überblick.

  • Zuverlässigkeit und Eigeninitiative sind für dich selbstverständlich. Du denkst lösungsorientiert und verfolgst deine Ziele mit gesundem Ehrgeiz.

  • Du verstehst dich als Teamplayer, der andere motivieren kann und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Abteilungen geschickt koordiniert.

  • Deine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke hilft dir dabei, komplexe Sachverhalte klar zu vermitteln und Probleme schnell aus der Welt zu schaffen.

  • Du hast eine echte Affinität für hochwertige Lebensmittel und begeisterst dich für deren handwerkliche oder industrielle Herstellung.

  • Du hast Lust auf neue Herausforderungen und möchtest dich fachlich wie persönlich mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickeln.

Das bieten wir:

title: (Senior) PR & Content Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at limehome
description_html:
Greif mit uns nach den Sternen!

Als (Senior) PR & Content Manager (m/f/d) gestaltest Du maßgeblich mit, wie Limehome als Marke in der Immobilien- und Hospitality-Branche wahrgenommen wird. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unser B2B Marketing und unsere PR-Kommunikation – mit direktem Draht zu unserem Leadership Team und viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem schnell wachsenden europäischen Hospitality-Scale-up.

Als 'Host with heart' bist du für diese Themen verantwortlich:

  • Du entwickelst unsere B2B-Kommunikationsstrategie eigenständig weiter und stellst sicher, dass Marketing- und PR-Maßnahmen konsistent auf unsere Unternehmensziele einzahlen.

  • Du koordinierst unsere PR-Agentur, verantwortest und steuerst unsere Kommunikationsstrategie, erstellst PR-Content selbst sowie in Zusammenarbeit mit der Agentur und baust unser Netzwerk an Journalistenkontakten aus.

  • Du verantwortest die Content-Erstellung und den Versand unseres B2B Newsletters.

  • Du bereitest unsere Auftritte auf Branchenevents und Konferenzen vor und koordinierst sie – von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung vor Ort.

  • Du organisierst unsere Opening Events für neue Standorte.

  • Du verantwortest unsere internen Sales-Dokumente und sorgst dafür, dass unser Vertriebsteam stets mit aktuellem Material arbeitet.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den Real-Estate-Bereich unserer Website.


Was Du brauchst, um mit uns nach den Sternen zu greifen:

  • Hochschulabschluss in Marketing, Kommunikation, BWL oder vergleichbar sowie 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Marketing und/oder in der PR.

  • Erfahrung darin, eine Kommunikations- oder Marketingstrategie nicht nur umzusetzen, sondern von Grund auf mitzuentwickeln. 

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Agenturen oder externen Dienstleistern; Du übernimmst gerne die Verantwortung für unsere Kommunikationsstrategie.

  • Ausgeprägte Content- und Storytelling-Skills – vom Newsletter bis zur Pressemitteilung überzeugst Du mit klarer, ansprechender Sprache.

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, auch wenn Du mehrere Projekte und Stakeholder (Sales, Expansion, Leadership) gleichzeitig im Blick behältst.

  • Kenntnisse der Immobilien-, Hospitality- oder PropTech-Branche sind von Vorteil.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift; Italienisch oder Spanisch sind ein Plus.

Darum wirst du Deinen ‘Aufenthalt’ bei uns lieben:

  • Hybrides Büromodell: Wir bieten ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld - Du kannst wählen, ob du zu 100% in unserem Büro oder teilweise von zu Hause und im Büro arbeiten möchtest.

  • Visum & Sprachunterstützung: Wir unterstützen dich bei deinem Visumsprozess und beim Erlernen der deutschen Sprache (nach bestandener Probezeit).

  • Umzugsunterstützung: Wir unterstützen dich finanziell bei deinem Umzug nach München, wenn du weiter als 300 km von unserem Büro entfernt wohnst.

  • Oneteam: Wir sind #oneteam mit einer transparenten Unternehmenskultur, indem wir uns durch Team-Standups, regelmäßige All-Hands und Team-Events (Sommer, Wiesn, Weihnachten) gegenseitig auf dem Laufenden halten.

  • Wachstum und Entwicklung: Wir sorgen dafür, dass du weiter wächst - durch ständiges Feedback, Peer Reviews und Austausch mit Fokus auf deine Entwicklung.

  • Grenzenloses Lernen: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, externe Weiterentwicklungsformate zu nutzen, die dich dabei unterstützen, dein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen, ohne dass du durch ein begrenztest Budget limitiert bist.

  • Workation: Du hast die Möglichkeit, zweimal pro Jahr für eine Dauer von bis zu 4 Wochen in einem anderen Land der Europäischen Union zu arbeiten. Unsere Limehomies lieben das Reisen, deshalb möchten wir dir die Möglichkeit geben, regelmäßig an neuen, inspirierenden Orten zu arbeiten.

  • Sabbatical: Nach 1,5 Jahren bei limehome bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit für ein 3-monatiges Sabbatical. Du kannst diese Zeit nutzen, um zu reisen, Zeit mit deinen Freunden zu verbringen oder dich ehrenamtlich zu engagieren.

  • Alles für unsere Limehomies: Wir kümmern uns um dein körperliches (Urban Sports Club) und um dein geistiges Wohlbefinden (Nilo.health). Darüber hinaus profitierst du von vergünstigten Tarifen für unsere Limehomes sowie von vielen weiteren Benefits. Komm zu uns und finde es heraus! 😉

    Über Limehome:

    Limehome ist ein führender, technologiebasierter Hospitality-Betreiber, der funktional gestaltete Designunterkünfte in ganz Europa anbietet. Durch den Einsatz seiner proprietären Technologie ermöglicht Limehome einen reibungslosen und komfortablen Aufenthalt mit einem nahtlosen digitalen Gästeerlebnis für Geschäfts- und Urlaubsreisende. Gegründet im Jahr 2018, beschäftigt Limehome heute über 300 Mitarbeitende und zählt über 10.000 Limehome Apartments und Hotelzimmer in 150 Städten in 13 europäischen Ländern.

title: Principal DevOps Engineer
description_html:
Company Description

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal DevOps Engineer to architect and evolve the platform that powers NBC’s broadcast production environments. As a senior technical leader on the NBC Production Application Engineering team, you will design a Kubernetes-native platform that automates the provisioning, lifecycle management, and delivery of cloud infrastructure at enterprise scale.

Our team leverages infrastructure-as-code, custom Kubernetes controllers, and GitOps workflows to orchestrate resources across complex multi-account and hybrid cloud environments. Built to support the complex demands of live broadcast production, this platform spans compute provisioning, dynamic software defined networking, hybrid DNS models, remote Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), and robust configuration management via Puppet. Because we operate at the cutting edge of the cloud-native ecosystem, we are never shy about contributing upstream to the open-source projects we rely on to improve our solutions and push the industry forward.

In this role, you will drive the technical vision of the platform. You will write production Go services, architect cloud-native solutions, and establish the engineering standards our teams rely on. This role requires deep fluency across Kubernetes internals, cloud infrastructure, Go systems programming, and a passion for mentoring engineers.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Platform Architecture & Vision: Architect a Kubernetes-native platform that models broadcast infrastructure as custom resources. Lead the technical strategy leveraging Crossplane compositions and custom Go functions to automate provisioning across multi-account AWS environments and on-prem control rooms.
  • Systems Engineering & Integrations: Design, build, and maintain production-grade Kubernetes operators, controllers, and internal platform APIs in Go. You will actively develop custom Crossplane providers to deeply integrate external enterprise platforms (such as NRCS, Venafi, and Infoblox) into our control plane, managing resource lifecycles and approval workflows.
  • Infrastructure & Networking Delivery: Lead the design of cloud networking, DNS strategies, and cross-account connectivity across hybrid environments, automating VPC topology and dynamic network routing.
  • Cross-Discipline Collaboration: Partner closely with broadcast systems engineers, system integrators, and external vendors to bridge the gap between broadcast hardware and automated infrastructure. You will lead efforts to "Puppet-ize" bare-metal compute configurations and integrate proprietary vendor solutions into our configuration-as-code ecosystem.
  • Technical Leadership: Serve as a technical authority for the team. Write RFCs, drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and establish high-confidence CI/CD pipelines, testing strategies, and GitHub Actions automation.
  • Access & Security Strategy: Own the platform's authorization model, designing hierarchical RBAC systems, resource identifier schemes, and identity integrations that enforce fine-grained access control.
  • Operational Excellence: Drive GitOps-based continuous delivery (Flux, Kustomize, Helm) and manage configuration-as-code for compute fleets using Puppet. Ensure deep operational visibility by designing comprehensive observability and alerting stacks.
  • VDI Integration: Oversee the integration of remote desktop/VDI connectivity solutions, focusing on session authentication, credential management, and gateway routing.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production infrastructure and cloud-native platforms at enterprise scale.
  • Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Go (systems-level programming, API servers) and deep experience building Kubernetes controllers/operators using patterns like controller-runtime and kubebuilder.
  • Kubernetes Internals: Expert-level knowledge of the Kubernetes ecosystem, including CRD/XRD generation, operators, informers, admission webhooks, and RBAC.
  • Crossplane & Control Planes: Deep production experience with Crossplane, including composite resources, composition functions, and specifically developing custom Crossplane providers in Go to integrate external enterprise platforms.
  • AWS & Networking: Extensive production experience with AWS multi-account architectures, cross-account networking patterns, and identity federation. Requires depth across EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, STS, SSM, Secrets Manager, Route 53, and S3.
  • GitOps Delivery: Production experience with GitOps tooling, specifically Flux (HelmRelease, Kustomization) or ArgoCD for continuous delivery on Kubernetes.
  • Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Puppet, including module development, PuppetDB, Hiera, and r10k.
  • APIs & Security: Experience designing REST APIs with middleware patterns and modern authentication (OAuth/JWT). Keen eye for information security, including cross-account IAM trust chains, least-privilege policies, JWT token lifecycles, and secrets abstraction.
  • Observability: Strong background in designing telemetry platforms using Grafana, Prometheus/Mimir, Loki, OpenTelemetry, and metrics collection agents (Alloy, Prometheus Node Exporter).
  • Databases: Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQLite or similar relational databases, encompassing schema design, migrations, and query optimization.
  • Communication: Excellent problem-solving skills with a proven ability to present architectural decisions to executives, engage with vendors, and write clear technical documentation.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity with broadcast/media production workflows and the strict operational constraints of live production environments.
  • Experience with the Crossplane function SDK for building custom composition functions in Go, and operating in Kubernetes disaster recovery situations (Velero cluster restoration, backups).
  • Familiarity with VDI Solutions (NICE DCV, Leostream, PCoIP, etc), machine identity workflows, and PKI certificate management (Venafi or similar).
  • Networking & Gateway: Experience with hybrid DNS architectures (Infoblox), software-defined networking (VPC peering, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, CloudWan), and Envoy Gateway / Gateway API.
  • Ecosystem Tooling: Familiarity with advanced testing frameworks (k6, KUTTL, etc), SOPS for encrypted GitOps configurations, and local development workflows (Air, kind/colima).
  • Scripting: Ability to script routine tasks in Bash and PowerShell.
  • Open Source: Active contributions to open-source projects, particularly within the CNCF / Kubernetes ecosystem.

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence. 

  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $180,000 - $230,000 (bonus eligible) 

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. 

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access nbcunicareers.com as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by emailing AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

For LA County and City Residents Only: NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

title: Sales Werkstudent (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aampere
description_html:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Wir ermöglichen es EV-Besitzer:innen, ihr Fahrzeug innerhalb von 48 Stunden zu verkaufen, und verschaffen Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundensegmenten. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, intransparent und schwer vertrauenswürdig, deshalb bauen wir die Infrastruktur, die das ändert, damit mehr Elektroautos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Wandel zur Elektromobilität wirklich an Fahrt aufnimmt.

Und es funktioniert: Wir steigern unseren Umsatz Jahr für Jahr um das Vierfache und halten bereits mehr als 1 % des deutschen Consumer-EV-Wiederverkaufsmarkts. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG.

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams.


Deine Mission

Du hast Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und Autos sind für dich nicht einfach nur Fortbewegungsmittel, sondern ein echtes Interesse? Dann bist du bei uns im Sales Team genau richtig. 

Operativer Vertrieb: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team dabei, Fahrzeuge für die Auktion vorzubereiten: von der Prüfung der Daten bis hin zur finalen Aufbereitung für die Plattform.
Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest unsere Verkäufer:innen durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess. Vom ersten telefonischen Kontakt bis zur Planung der Übergabe sorgst du dafür, dass intern alles reibungslos läuft.
Sales-Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Ideen ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten.
Feedback für Produkt und Team: Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt weiter und hilfst so, unser Produkt gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.
Startup-Alltag: Du bringst dich dort ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, mit deinen individuellen Stärken und Interessen.


Das bringst du mit

Dein Background: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Dein Studiengang ist für uns zweitrangig, viel wichtiger sind deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und dein Blick für saubere Prozesse.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, telefonierst gerne und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl.
Interesse an Autos: Kein Muss, aber definitiv ein Plus, denn du wirst viel mit Fahrzeugdaten arbeiten.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge schnell bewegen, zeigst Eigeninitiative und willst aktiv mitgestalten statt nur Dienst nach Vorschrift zu leisten.
Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift.


Why Aampere?

Wachstum & Ownership: Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt: im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du entsprechend schnell aufsteigen. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle.
Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten: direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad.
Chance auf Übernahme: Wenn du besonders gut bist, wollen wir, dass du bleibst. Denk von Anfang an nicht daran, wo das endet, sondern wo es hinführen könnte.


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind.
...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.
...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.
...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.
...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Wie wir arbeiten

Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.
Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen.
Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.


Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss

Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht.

title: Founding Brand Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Aampere
description_html:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo.


Deine Mission

Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.

Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen
Tech: Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.
Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. 


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.

...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.

...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.

...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Wie wir arbeiten

Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.
Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen.
Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.


Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss

Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht.
