title: Enterprise Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Develocity
description_html:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We're at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, the context-engineering layer for AI-driven software delivery used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration and efficiency, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, Bazel, npm, and Python, with support for additional build tools coming soon.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as DuckDuckGo, Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for a hardworking, driven Account Executive to join our high-performing team. In this role, you will be the face of Develocity for enterprise prospects and customers in the New York and East Coast US region, focusing on driving revenue growth and new business acquisition.

You'll act as a primary point of contact for our enterprise accounts in your territory. Your goal will be to guide these organizations on their journey with Develocity to unlock comprehensive data throughout the build process, empowering you to detect the unknown unknowns so you can ship faster, reduce risk, and lower costs, all while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance. You will be responsible for formulating and executing a sales strategy to grow your territory and acquire new customers.

Responsibilities

As an Account Executive, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead to close, to expand Develocity adoption. Your main focus will be to consistently achieve or exceed quotas and drive pipeline growth.

You will do this by:

  • Developing and executing strategic account plans to target new logos not already covered by other teams.
  • Building a robust pipeline and preparing accurate forecasts for large-scale, multi-year deals.
  • Cultivating strong customer relationships and consistently engaging with key engineering and C-level executives.
  • Leading the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to close.
  • Clearly articulating the value of Develocity and providing customer feedback to enhance our product.
  • Mastering sales techniques like MEDPICC and Command of the Message to execute deals effectively.
  • Attending industry events and Develocity-hosted sessions to strengthen relationships and generate new business.
  • Analyzing wins and losses and sharing insights with internal teams to improve our approach.
  • Documenting best practices in our sales playbook to contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Being willing to travel to meet customers in person.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct sales experience selling enterprise software to executives in large, complex organizations.
  • A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quotas.
  • Experience in the DevOps, Observability, or CI/CD space.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present to C-level executives.
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and/or consultative sales techniques. Knowledge of MEDDPICC is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the following sales tools: Salesforce, SalesLoft, ZoomInfo, and Gong.
  • AI-first mindset to help with automating everyday tasks. 

What We Offer

  • Ability to work in a remote-first environment with flexible working hours.
  • Work on a fast-growing product with a clear vision for the future.
  • Close collaboration with an ambitious and experienced team and the opportunity to learn from them regardless of your experience level.
  • Opportunities for growth in your career and in leadership responsibilities.
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite team meetings, and onboardings.
  • Contribute to leading solutions in the new industry of Developer Productivity Engineering and work with cutting-edge DPE tools and practices.
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants.

Location

Remote from Europe.

While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.

title: Site Reliability Engineer – Quantum Computing (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at eleQtron GmbH
description_html:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (m/f/d) to join our team in Hamburg. You will maintain and support the reliability, scalability, and operability of the software systems powering our trapped-ion quantum computers.

Responsibilities:

As a Site Reliability Engineer – Quantum Computing (f/m/d), you will contribute to the reliability, stability, and operability of our software that operates our quantum computers. You will work closely with software engineers, firmware developers, physicists, and hardware engineers in an interdisciplinary environment, gaining deep insight into a cutting-edge technical domain. This is an on-site position in Siegen or Hamburg. Depending on your background, you will work on the following tasks:

  • Contribute to the reliability of the quantum control and quantum program execution stack

  • Support the definition and refinement of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and operational guardrails

  • Implement and maintain observability across software, infrastructure, and hardware-adjacent layers

  • Participate in incident response, post-mortems, and root cause analyses for system failures

  • Identify operational risks and propose mitigation strategies

  • Drive automation initiatives to reduce toil and improve system stability

  • Maintain operational standards, runbooks, and documentation

  • Contribute to CI/CD and release processes with a focus on reliability and safe deployments

  • Collaborate with development teams to support production-ready system design


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 2–4 years of professional experience in SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Systems engineering

  • Experience operating and stabilizing complex systems in production or lab environments

  • Hands-on experience with containerized and orchestrated environments

  • Practical knowledge of monitoring, alerting, and observability tooling

  • Experience participating in incident response processes

  • Good technical documentation skills

  • Ability to reason through engineering trade-offs

  • Fluent written and spoken English

We value:

  • Experience in hardware-adjacent, lab, or cyber-physical systems

  • Background in scientific, research, or experimental environments

  • Strong Python skills for automation and tooling

  • Experience with long-running, stateful workloads

  • Familiarity with firmware, control systems, or real-time constraints

  • Experience with programmatic device control (e.g. SCPI, serial, USB, TCP/IP)

  • Prior exposure to quantum computing or other deep-tech domains


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications 

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. We are looking for a QA Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen.

You will take ownership of quality across our software platform, from compilation services and the public API to the interfaces used by our operators and customers.

This is a build-from-scratch role: there is no ready-made test suite waiting for you, and no expensive tool that does the thinking for you. You define what good testing looks like here, and then you build it.

You are as comfortable writing a test strategy on a blank page as you are writing the automation that implements it in code.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the testing approach for our platform end-to-end: define what to test, at which level, and why

  • Write test concepts from scratch — risk-based, covering unit, integration, system, and end-to-end levels, and turn them into running, maintained automation

  • Build and own our test automation frameworks in code, integrated directly into our CI/CD pipelines, using your defined tooling

  • Do the exploratory and manual testing that automation can't cover, and know where that line sits

  • Establish quality gates, coverage expectations, and clear bug-reporting practices the whole team can work with

  • Work closely with backend, platform, and hardware teams to test at the boundaries where software meets the machine

  • Raise the testing literacy of the engineering team, so quality is a shared habit rather than a gate at the end


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years in software quality assurance, with real ownership of test strategy, not only executing predefined test scripts

  • Ability to design a test concept for an unfamiliar system: choosing the right test levels, techniques, and priorities from first principles

  • Confident programming ability (Python preferred), enough to build and maintain automation yourself rather than depend on record-and-playback tools

  • Hands-on experience with open-source testing frameworks (e.g. pytest, Playwright, Selenium) and integrating tests into CI/CD

  • Solid grounding in testing fundamentals: test design techniques, the test pyramid, API testing, and when to automate versus test manually

  • A generalist, tool-agnostic mindset, you pick the right approach for the problem, not the one tool you already know

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Experience setting up a QA function or test strategy in an early-stage or greenfield environment

  • Testing distributed systems, APIs, or cloud-native services

  • Performance, load, or security testing experience

  • Exposure to hardware-in-the-loop or lab/control-software testing

  • ISTQB certification, or an equivalent grounding in test theory you actually apply

  • Prior exposure to quantum computing or other deep-tech domains

title: Senior People Partner (all genders)

description_html:
About us
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

To achieve our ambitious goals, we’re looking for a Senior People Partner to join our People team and support our Engineering & Product teams. You will provide strategic business partnerships and coaching, develop people-related solutions to meet critical business needs and positively shape the Distribusion people experience.

What you will do:

  • You will be the first People Partner and work closely with the VP of People to onboard yourself into Distribusion's current People philosophies, practices, and processes.

  • You will partner with the Engineering and Product functions to sustainably achieve their growth and development goals.

  • You will partner with the other People functions on all aspects of employment experience.

  • You will build our management team’s capacity through coaching and influencing.

  • You will contribute to the strategy of the teams you support and to the direction of the People Business Partner team.

  • You will foster excellence in the support, motivation, retention, and growth of our talent.


Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid

We are looking for this role based at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.


Who you are:

  • You bring extensive experience in People Business Partner roles in Germany or the European region.

  • Experience in successfully supporting and developing functions in high-growth phases.

  • You demonstrate outstanding judgment and make consistently good decisions for the company and our team members.

  • You know firsthand the challenges of a growth-stage company, anticipate scaling problems, and are adaptable and curious.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of designing and implementing people programs.

  • Strong leadership qualities with experience managing projects.

  • Proficiency in HRIS systems and KPIs and a keen interest in leveraging AI and other emerging technologies.

  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to liaise with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Fluency in English, both verbal and written.

  • Passionate about the people's development, enablement and success, resonating with the purpose behind the role.

  • Driven, ambitious, and willing to get hands-on in shaping the future of ground transportation travel.

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Implico Gmbh
description_html:
Your mission

Cloud Native Node.js & AI-enabled Product with SAP Private Cloud Integration | Senior / Principal Level 

As Senior Technical Architect – Hybrid, you own the technical design across our two worlds: the cloud-native, AI-enabled product line built on modern Node.js architectures, and its integration into the SAP Private Cloud platform landscape. 
Your focus is approximately 70% Public Cloud product architecture and 30% SAP Private Cloud platform architecture. You are the architect who makes the hybrid seam work – ensuring that public cloud innovation and the SAP core evolve as one coherent, scalable, and future-proof landscape rather than two disconnected estates. 

Your Responsibilities 

  • Cloud-Native Product Architecture (Primary Focus)
Design of microservices architectures on Node.js 
API-first and event-driven architecture concepts 
Definition of service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns 
Ensuring multi-tenant capability and tenant isolation 
Non-functional design: performance, scalability, resilience, cost 
  • AI Integration in Product
Technical architecture for AI features in the product 
Integration of LLMs or AI services within defined guardrails 
Design of RAG and agentic patterns over product and platform data 
Performance and cost optimization of AI-driven features 
  • Hybrid Integration Architecture (Public ↔ Private Cloud)
Design of the integration layer between cloud-native products and SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud 
API and event contracts across the hybrid boundary (OData, REST, SAP Business Events, Event Mesh) 
Data ownership, consistency, and synchronisation patterns across both estates 
Identity, authorisation, and trust propagation across the hybrid landscape 
  • SAP Private Cloud Platform Architecture (Secondary Focus)
Architectural guidance for S/4HANA Private Cloud extensions and side-by-side scenarios 
Enforcement of clean core principles and SAP development standards 
Architectural review of SAP-side designs together with the SAP Private Cloud & SCM architect 
Awareness of core SCM process flows (SD, MM, EWM) as they surface into product capabilities 
  • DevOps & Deployment Architecture
Collaboration with infrastructure and deployment engineers across both estates 
Architecture design for containerization and cloud deployment 
CI/CD and environment strategy spanning public and private cloud pipelines 
  • Design Governance
Creation of HLD, SDD, and TDD up to epic level 
Technical review and sign-off responsibility in the Architecture Board 
Translation of enterprise guardrails into actionable design standards for teams 

Organizational Context 

  • Embedded in the Engineering function
  • Senior / Principal Level
  • Part of the Architecture Board
  • Operates within guardrails defined by the Enterprise Architect
  • Works in close tandem with the Technical Architect – Public Cloud and the Technical Architect – SAP Private Cloud & SCM


Your profile

  • Several years of experience as an architect in cloud-native environments
  • Strongexpertisein Node.js
  • Experience with microservices and API architectures
  • Strong understanding of event-driven systems
  • Experience integrating AI into software products
  • Cloud architecture experience (containers, orchestration, scaling)
  • Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud and clean core extension patterns
  • Proventrack recorddesigning integration between cloud-native applications and an ERP core
  • High technical credibility with senior engineers in both cloud-native and SAP teamsPlus 
  • Experience with SAP BTP and SAP CAP (Node.js/CDS)
  • Experience with RISE with SAP orhyperscaler-hosted SAP environments
  • Exposure to SCM processes and SAP modules (SD, MM, EWM)
  • Experience with ABAP / RAP at review levelechnology Stack 
  • Public Cloud & Product (≈70%)
Node.js, TypeScript, microservices, API-first design 
Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes / Kyma), Cloud Foundry 
Event-Driven Architecture, SAP Event Mesh, SAP Business Events 
CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability 
  • SAP Platform & Extensions (≈30%)
SAP BTP, SAP CAP (Node.js/CDS) 
S/4HANA Private Cloud and Public Cloud side-by-side extensions 
Clean Core OData APIs, ABAP / RAP (at review level) 
  • Data & AI
HANA Cloud (HDI, Vector Engine) 
Generative AI / SAP AI Core, RAG, LLM integration 
LangChain / LangGraph, agentic orchestration 
  • Infrastructure & Security
Multi-Tenant Architecture 
XSUAA / IAS / IPS, identity federation across hybrid landscapes 
CI/CD (SAP and non-SAP toolchains) 

AI Readiness 

We expect our architects to work with AI, not just design for it. We assess AI readiness on two levels. 
  • General AI Working Practice
Habitual, critical use of AI assistants in daily engineering and design work 
Ability to judge where AI output is trustworthy and where it must be verified 
Awareness of data protection, IP, and confidentiality boundaries when using AI tools 
Willingness to share prompts, patterns, and lessons learned with the wider engineering organisation 
  • Role-Specific AI Usage
AI-assisted architecture work: option analysis, trade-off exploration, design review support 
AI-assisted generation and maintenance of HLD, SDD, and TDD artefacts 
Use of AI coding assistants for prototypes, spikes, and reference implementations 
Designing AI-native product capabilities: RAG over product and SAP data, agentic workflows, guardrails and evaluation 
Assessing AI features for cost, latency, and operational risk before they enter the architecture


Why us?

You hold the hybrid landscape together. You build the foundation for scalable public cloud products, enable AI-native capabilities and ensure the SAP core and cloud-native product portfolio evolve as one. Your role enables innovation to scale at pace while keeping the platform stable, governed, and coherent.

title: SAP Account Executive (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Implico Gmbh
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 "Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, Analyze & Report (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Solactive
description_html:
Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.


Job Overview

As a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer in the ANR team, you will be primarily abackend engineer with fullstack capabilities (~80% backend / 20% frontend). You willdesign, build, and operate the services and pipelines that aggregate financial data,render client-facing documents, and deliver them through APIs and automated pushmechanisms. You will also contribute to the internal tooling and lightweight frontendsthat support the team's products.You will take ownership of complex features end-to-end, drive technical decisionswithin your area, mentor less experienced engineers, and collaborate with DevOpsand other engineering teams. We are looking for engineers who don't wait to be toldwhat to build next, who proactively spot gaps, propose improvements, and turnambiguity into shipped work.


Your Tasks

  • Design, implement, and operate backend services in Java (Spring Boot) that powerdata aggregation, rendering, and customer delivery.
  • Integrate with Apache Kafka and GCP Pub/Sub for event-driven data flows;consume, transform, and cache data from upstream data points in a reliable andrecoverable manner.
  • Build and maintain public APIs and automated document delivery pipelines (pushto customer servers, on-demand retrieval).
  • Contribute to the document rendering architecture, keeping it extensible for bothstandard and custom, client-specific documents, and actively pushing documentsout rather than only exposing them passively.
  • Develop the internal frontend tooling required by the team and its products; helpdefine the frontend stack as the team evolves.
  • Write SQL and work with relational databases, including query optimization and schema design for reporting workloads.
  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and contribute to DevOps practices within the team.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, promote engineering best practices, andcontribute to code reviews and knowledge sharing.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements intoreliable technical solutions, and explain complex technical trade-offs back to themin plain language


Your Profile

Must Have

  •  7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend focus.
  • Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, including production-grade service
    design.
  • Solid experience with Apache Kafka (or comparable event streaming platforms).
  • Experience designing and operating services on a major public cloud (GCP, AWS,
    or Azure); cloud-agnostic mindset, ability to transfer skills across providers.
    Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with relational databases.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Practical fullstack ability: comfortable building internal tooling / lightweight
    frontends; frontend framework can be defined together with the team.
  • Track record of designing scalable, resilient systems and taking features from
    concept to production.
  • A proactive mindset: you spot gaps and opportunities before they're handed to
    you, and you act on them.
  • A strong drive for teamwork: you collaborate across functions, share context
    generously, and lift the people around you rather than optimizing solo.
  • The ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and
    make trade-offs legible to the business
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, mentoring mindset.
Nice to have
  • Experience with GCP in particular (Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage / buckets).
  • Working knowledge of Python (the team has Python components).
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript.
  • Experience with document generation / rendering pipelines (PDF, XLS/CSV,
    templated reports).
  • Familiarity with the financial domain, index data, or reporting for financial
    institutions and regulatory bodies.
  • Experience designing and exposing public APIs for external clients


Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive
  • FinTech Excellence: Experience FinTech excellence at Solactive
  • Modern Culture: Enjoy our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture
  • Responsibility & Connections: Take over responsibility from day one and build relationships in- and outside the company
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 annual vacation days, plus extra time off for Christmas Eve and New Year
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package
  • Special Benefits: Job ticket, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space with ergonomic set-up, employee lounge, and free beverages and fruits
  • Community & Networking: Engage in our various networking events
  • Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offers
  • Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, including a hybrid work model, all within a diverse and dynamic environment


Your Application

This role sounds like you? Then we look forward to receiving your application.  Please make sure to also upload your CV, a cover letter is not compulsory. If you have any further questions just drop us an email! Your contact person is Roopali Sahoo.
Want to know more about life at Solactive? Visit Work@ Solactive  
  
Please Note 
No artificial intelligence (AI) is used in the screening, assessment, or selection of candidates for this position. 
Solactive does not charge candidates any fees at any stage of the recruitment process and will never request payment for CV enhancement, interviews, training, equipment, or other recruitment-related services. Please be cautious of fake profiles or fraudulent messages claiming to represent Solactive. If you are unsure whether a communication is legitimate, contact us at . 
Solactive does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any cooperation request must be addressed directly to People & Culture. Costs related to unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles will not be covered by Solactive.

description_html:
Company Description

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency, and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!


Job Overview

Our Market Data team forms an essential link between our business and infrastructure teams: it defines and implements business processes in data pipelines, monitors existing services, and thereby provides the best service to our customers. As a Senior Software Developer in our Market Data team, you will be working on a broad set of real-world problems. Highly effective data management, resilience, and fail-over strategies are some of our most important topics. In close collaboration with our business analysts and data engineers, you will create high-performance data processing solutions that scale using emerging technologies and approaches and help us define new best practices. 

Our continuous business growth and high requirements on accuracy, performance, and availability will provide you with a lot of engineering challenges and opportunities to contribute, to learn, and to grow as part of our team.   

You love solving complex problems, building performant, scalable, low latency, and highly available services. Then we can’t wait to meet you!


Your Tasks

  • Designing and implementing challenging projects to develop our data processing pipeline.
  • Building up a data landscape that acts as the single source of all relevant data in the long run.
  • Engineering ETL processes.
  • Developing high performance APIs and streaming solutions to our clients and data vendors.
  • Being an in-house consultant for best track, store, and access data.


Your Profile

  • 8+ years of software development, data engineering, or relevant experience, including at least 5 years of in-depth Python experience.
  • Software Engineering: good understanding of microservice architectures, Liskov’s Substitution Principle, design patterns, and dynamic dispatch.
  • Databases: experience with at least one SQL/NoSQL database, such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, including schema definition and evolution, as well as ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy, JPA, or Hibernate.
  • Cloud / Cloud-native development: Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • CI/CD: ability to define build pipelines and perform, validate, and monitor deployments.
  • Good understanding of microservice architectures.
  • Ability to define Docker images according to the Twelve-Factor App methodology.
  • Git: ability to use Git from the command line and apply version-control management practices (e.g., Gitflow, trunk-based development).
  • Strong technical mentoring skills.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Communication: ability to illustrate ideas and concepts with figurative examples to both stakeholders and developers.
  • Ability to perceive the business domain in terms of mathematical structures is appreciated.


Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family, a motivated team with an international setting.
  • Get to know the dynamics of an established, successful FinTech company.
  • Free choice of your gears to work comfortably and effectively.
  • Experience a modern start-up culture with a flat hierarchy.
  • Seize the opportunity to develop personally, take over responsibility and maintain direct customer contact from day one.
  • Flexible work environment with a hybrid work model and 30 annual vacation days.
  • Receive numerous benefits (e.g. Regular staff parties, team events, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space, activity room, free beverages and fruit baskets).


Your Application

Interested? Don’t miss your chance and directly apply online by clicking the “Apply now” button on our website and filling in the application form. Please make sure to also upload your CV, a cover letter is not compulsory. Your contact person is Anastasiia Nosenkova ( 
To all recruitment agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs/Candidate Profiles. Please do not forward any CVs/Candidate Profiles to any Solactive employee in any location. Any requests for cooperation have to be addressed directly to HR. Any costs associated with unsolicited CVs/Candidate Profiles are not being covered by Solactive.

title: Team Lead AI Engineering (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vestigas
description_html:
We're digitizing the construction industry – are you in?

At VESTIGAS, you build the digital backbone of the construction supply chain. We turn purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices into a digital, legally compliant platform used in everyday operations by construction companies and suppliers. You’ll work on a product with real market traction in the DACH mid-market, ship iteratively, and take ownership of solutions that must work in the field—not just in theory.


Your Role

As Team Lead – AI Engineering, you'll own the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform end to end – from pipeline design to production deployment. You bring prior leadership experience and are ready to lead a team of AI engineers: setting technical direction, growing your team's capabilities, and making sure the team consistently delivers reliable, scalable AI systems.

The Technical ChallengeYour team will tackle problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough." This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the team navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters.


Your Mission

  • Lead and long-term grow a team of AI engineers, providing both strategical technical direction and people leadership
  • Own MLOps processes and infrastructure, ensuring our AI systems are reliable, scalable, and secure
  • Drive the design and implementation of advanced AI features, partnering closely with engineering and product leadership to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines
  • Set the bar for accuracy, efficiency, and uncertainty estimation of our AI features through rigorous testing practices
  • Ensure the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and drive the build of new ones from scratch
  • Translate customer needs into technical priorities and represent AI engineering in strategic product and sales discussions
  • Establish and evolve engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices across the team
  • Coach and develop your team members, supporting their technical and professional growth
  • Champion the use of modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor across the team


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
  • 5+ years of experience in AI engineering and at least 1+ years in a leading position, including end-to-end lifecycle management and MLOps
  • Proven experience leading or managing a technical team, with strong people-leadership skills
  • Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
  • A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
  • A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
  • Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
  • Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week


Your Benefits

  • Real ownership instead of micromanagement. You shape, you decide, and you see the impact of your work directly in the market.
  • Direct line to founders and leadership. Flat hierarchies are our everyday reality – short paths, fast decisions.
  • AI-First workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor & co. are standard tools for us. We expect and support their use.
  • Hybrid work with an office in the heart of Munich, just around the corner from Theresienwiese. Flexible setup with regular office presence – because we believe the best ideas happen in person.
  • EGYM Wellpass or BahnCard, corporate benefits, team events, annual offsites.
  • Fair, competitive compensation.

title: (Senior) Marketing Manager – Events & Partnerships (d/w/m*)

description_html:
Warum wir?

Bei pixx.io bist du Teil eines ambitionierten und unterstützenden Teams, das ein gemeinsames Ziel verfolgt: Unseren über 1.600 Kunden eine erstklassige SaaS-Lösung für Digital Asset Management (DAM) zu bieten und gleichzeitig neue Unternehmen von unserer Software zu begeistern. Gemeinsam machen wir digitales Arbeiten smarter und erfolgreicher – und du kannst einen wichtigen Beitrag dazu leisten.

Freue dich auf:

  • ein Marketing-Team, das Themen eigenverantwortlich vorantreibt und dich als zentrale Schnittstelle für Events und Partnerschaften willkommen heißt,
  • direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing-, Sales- und Partner-Verantwortlichen sowie sichtbaren Impact auf unsere GTM-Strategie,
  • moderne und nachhaltige Büros in Mühldorf (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mVc3LBJ8C9Q) und in München (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9hoq8-16O48), wobei du frei auswählen kannst, ob du an einem unserer Standorte (gerne auch hybrid) arbeitest – was wir bevorzugen würden – oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands,
  • echte gelebte Hybrid Kultur: 2 On-Sites pro Jahr in unserem Headquarter für Workshops & Teambuildings in Persona,
  • unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit (40 Std.) ab 01.01.2027,
  • 30 Urlaubstage + jeweils einen freien Tag am 24.12. und 31.12.,
  • marktgerechtes Gehalt je nach Skill- und Erfahrungslevel,
  • offene Fehler- und Feedbackkultur,
  • tolle Weiterbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten,
  • modernste Ausstattung, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze im Büro, Mitarbeitende werben Mitarbeitende-Programm, Zusammenhalt fördernde Events und spaßige Firmenfeiern, faire Regelungen zu Workations innerhalb der EU, vergünstigte Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Corporate Benefits & Co.


Deine Aufgaben

Du behältst bei mehreren Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick, denkst in Prozessen und liebst es, Events und Partnerschaften von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung zu bringen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig! Du als (Senior) Marketing Manager – Events & Partnerships (d/w/m*) verantwortest unsere Marketing Kanäle Events und Partnerships vollumfänglich – von der Strategie bis zur operativen Umsetzung.

Was dich erwartet:

  • Messe- & Event-Management: Du planst und steuerst unsere Auftritte auf Messen wie der DMEXCO und der K5 von Stand- und Eventkonzept über Budget, Bewerbung und Durchführung bis hin zur Nachbereitung inklusive Lead-Übergabe an den Vertrieb.
  • Online Events: Du planst und steuerst unsere Webinare, egal ob selbst gehostet oder durch Partner/Plattformen. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen von der Konzeption über Projektmanagement bis zur Erfolgskontrolle.
  • Partner-Marketing & Enablement: Du konzipierst und organisierst Formate wie Meet-ups oder einen virtuellen Partner-Day und baust unser Partner-Enablement kontinuierlich aus.
  • Schnittstellenfunktion: Du arbeitest als Teil des Marketings eng mit Sales, CSM und externen Partnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass alle Projekte termingerecht, budgetkonform und mit klarem Erfolgsmaß umgesetzt werden.


Dein Profil

Bei uns zählt jede einzelne Person – dein Impact macht den Unterschied. Wir suchen eine Person, die unsere Kanäle 'Events' & 'Partnerships' nicht nur organisiert, sondern strategisch weiterentwickelt – mit Hands-on-Mentalität und einem Gespür für Priorisierung.

Idealerweise bringst du zudem folgende Qualifikationen mit:

  • Erfahrung im Marketing (Events, Partnerships): Du hast mindestens 4-5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Marketing, am Besten mit Kampagnen- oder Eventmanagement Schwerpunkt, bevorzugt in der SaaS oder Tech-Branche.
  • Budget- & Ressourcenkontrolle: Du hast Erfahrung in der effizienten Steuerung von Event- und Marketing-Budgets und behältst Kosten sowie Ressourceneinsatz jederzeit im Blick.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: Du verhandelst sicher mit Partnern, Dienstleistern und Sponsoring-Partnern und erzielst dabei für beide Seiten Deals mit Mehrwert.
  • Analytisches Mindset: Du misst und analysierst den Erfolg deiner Maßnahmen anhand klarer KPIs und triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert statt aus dem Bauch heraus. Du hast immer einen Blick darauf, wo wir noch effizienter werden können und wo Potenziale für Skalierung liegen.
  • Organisationstalent mit Umsetzungsstärke: Du behältst bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick, setzt Prioritäten und lieferst zuverlässig termingerecht.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst Ownership für deine Projekte und triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig, ohne dabei den Blick fürs große Ganze zu verlieren.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, für Messen und Partner-Events gelegentlich zu reisen.
  • Deutsch (C1/C2) & Englisch (mind. B2): Du bewegst dich sicher in nationalen sowie internationalen Partnerbeziehungen.

title: AI Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mirakl - Labs
description_html:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

 

Annual gross salary range (package): €55,000 – €65,000
This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems

title: Enterprise Account Executive

description_html:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We're at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, the context-engineering layer for AI-driven software delivery used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration and efficiency, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, Bazel, npm, and Python, with support for additional build tools coming soon.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as DuckDuckGo, Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for a hardworking, driven Account Executive to join our high-performing team. In this role, you will be the face of Develocity for enterprise prospects and customers in the New York and East Coast US region, focusing on driving revenue growth and new business acquisition.

You'll act as a primary point of contact for our enterprise accounts in your territory. Your goal will be to guide these organizations on their journey with Develocity to unlock comprehensive data throughout the build process, empowering you to detect the unknown unknowns so you can ship faster, reduce risk, and lower costs, all while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance. You will be responsible for formulating and executing a sales strategy to grow your territory and acquire new customers.

Responsibilities

As an Account Executive, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead to close, to expand Develocity adoption. Your main focus will be to consistently achieve or exceed quotas and drive pipeline growth.

You will do this by:

  • Developing and executing strategic account plans to target new logos not already covered by other teams.
  • Building a robust pipeline and preparing accurate forecasts for large-scale, multi-year deals.
  • Cultivating strong customer relationships and consistently engaging with key engineering and C-level executives.
  • Leading the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to close.
  • Clearly articulating the value of Develocity and providing customer feedback to enhance our product.
  • Mastering sales techniques like MEDPICC and Command of the Message to execute deals effectively.
  • Attending industry events and Develocity-hosted sessions to strengthen relationships and generate new business.
  • Analyzing wins and losses and sharing insights with internal teams to improve our approach.
  • Documenting best practices in our sales playbook to contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Being willing to travel to meet customers in person.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct sales experience selling enterprise software to executives in large, complex organizations.
  • A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quotas.
  • Experience in the DevOps, Observability, or CI/CD space.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present to C-level executives.
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and/or consultative sales techniques. Knowledge of MEDDPICC is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the following sales tools: Salesforce, SalesLoft, ZoomInfo, and Gong.
  • AI-first mindset to help with automating everyday tasks. 

What We Offer

  • Ability to work in a remote-first environment with flexible working hours.
  • Work on a fast-growing product with a clear vision for the future.
  • Close collaboration with an ambitious and experienced team and the opportunity to learn from them regardless of your experience level.
  • Opportunities for growth in your career and in leadership responsibilities.
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite team meetings, and onboardings.
  • Contribute to leading solutions in the new industry of Developer Productivity Engineering and work with cutting-edge DPE tools and practices.
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants.

Location

Remote from Europe.

While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.

title: AI Software Engineer (AI Lab)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Agicap
description_html:
About Agicap


Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !


Agicap est en train de devenir une AI-first company. Nous formons l'ensemble de nos employés à travailler avec l'IA et à automatiser eux-mêmes une partie de leurs tâches. Certains projets sont trop longs, trop transverses ou trop techniques pour être portés par une équipe métier seule.

C'est le rôle de l'AI Lab.

C'est l'équipe pivot qui construit les outils internes qui changent la façon dont Agicap travaille au quotidien. Notre boussole : impact opérationnel rapide, itérations courtes, travail à 360° avec toutes les équipes (Sales, CS, Finance, Produit, Marketing, Data, C-level).

C'est une création de poste : l'accélération de l'IA change nos process et notre manière de bosser. On a besoin d'un renfort senior pour accompagner cette transition et l'inscrire dans des pratiques qui tiennent sur le long terme.

L'équipe que tu vas rejoindre : 
  • 3 personnes, toi inclus : un ingénieur IA junior, un Tech Lead à mi-temps (qui sera ton manager), un Product Manager.
  • Ton rôle : apporter le recul technique qui manque aujourd'hui dans l'équipe (infra, architecture, maintenabilité, scalabilité) — construire vite, mais sans creuser de dette pour demain.
  • Tu es en interaction directe avec toutes les équipes métier d'Agicap : c'est un poste très transverse, très exposé.

⚡️ Responsabilités :

Tu alternes entre cadrage rapide, build et itération :

  • Comprendre le besoin d'une équipe métier en direct, cadrer ce qui a réellement de l'impact vs. ce qui est du confort, prioriser.
  • Construire les outils internes de bout en bout : cadrage → dev → mise en prod → itération avec les utilisateurs.
  • Faire évoluer la plateforme IA commune : serveurs MCP, intégrations, outillage transverse mis à disposition de toute l'entreprise.
  • Prendre les décisions techniques qui structurent le Lab : infra, choix de stack, architecture. Il n'y a pas d'existant lourd auquel te conformer, tu construis pour scaler.
  • Élever le niveau technique de l'équipe : mentoring de l'IA Engineer junior, transmission des bonnes pratiques, revue de code utile.
  • Identifier proactivement les process où l'IA apporte un vrai gain — et construire la solution.

    • Exemples de chantiers sur tes 6 premiers mois :

    • Feedback loop produit : construire un système qui digère l'ensemble des logs de feedback client (calls, RFP, remontées CS) et produit des recommandations priorisées pour les Product Managers. Aujourd'hui la donnée existe mais on ne la digère pas.
    • Chantier infra MCP : mettre à disposition des collaborateurs Agicap des serveurs MCP connectés à leurs outils du quotidien, à l'échelle.

⚡️Comment on travaille :
  • Autonomie totale : équipe de 3, tu décides, tu assumes tes choix.
  • Ship rate élevé : on livre quotidiennement, on mesure, on itère. Pas de sprints à la papa.
  • Full remote ou hybride Lyon/Paris, comme tu préfères. Venues à Lyon possibles (~1 fois toutes les 6 semaines) mais jamais obligatoires.
  • IA au quotidien dans le delivery : on utilise Claude, OpenAI, Mistral au quotidien pour construire — on n'observe pas la vague IA, on est dedans.
  • Anglais requis : beaucoup de collaborateurs sont anglophones. Ton binôme est francophone.

    • 👀 Le profil recherché:

    On vise un profil senior avec expérience de Tech Lead — quelqu'un qui a déjà pris des décisions impactantes, poussé des sujets techniques exigeants, et exploré activement le terrain IA :

    • ~4-5 ans d'expérience minimum en dev, sur des projets réellement mis en production.
    • Expérience de Tech Lead ou équivalent : tu as déjà driver des décisions d'architecture et d'infra, tu sais arbitrer entre vélocité et dette.
    • Pratique concrète et récente des LLMs : tu as essayé des choses, poussé des expérimentations, testé Claude / OpenAI / Mistral. Tu es moteur sur ces sujets, pas suiveur.
    • Python et TypeScript dans ta boîte à outils. Le langage compte moins que ta capacité à choisir le bon outil pour le bon problème.
    • Bases techniques solides : tu maîtrises et comprends ce que tu livres.
    • Capacité à livrer vite et à prioriser ce qui a réellement de l'impact — mode Doer, pas mode powerpoint.
    • Proactivité et curiosité : tu identifies des opportunités que personne n'a formulées, tu vas chercher.
    • Anglais professionnel courant.
    • Autonomie assumée : dans une équipe de 3, tu ne peux pas te cacher. 

    ⭐ Stack et outillage
  • LLMs : Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI, Mistral — l'équipe n'est pas mono-provider, tu choisis le bon modèle pour le bon usage.
  • Langages : majoritairement Python et TypeScript.
  • Infra : à toi de la construire, avec un vrai droit de décision — pas d'existant lourd.
  • Outillage IA en interne : serveurs MCP, plateforme IA commune, agents connectés aux outils métier.
  • Cycle : Continuous Delivery, mise en prod quotidienne, feedback utilisateur direct.

    • 🎁 Ce qu'on offre
    • Un poste à impact direct et visible dans une AI-first company de 600 personnes.
    • Un cadre ultra-responsabilisant : autonomie, ownership, décisions techniques à ton niveau.
    • Rémunération : 55K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC.
    • CDI, forfait en heures, 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées.
    • 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée).

Job summary (Short promotional text)

We are looking for a Senior Consultant to strengthen our European Grants team in France.

You will advise innovative companies and organisations on European funding strategies and lead the development of complex grant applications for major R&D, industrial and innovation projects.

The role combines strategic consulting, project analysis, proposal writing and client management. We are looking for someone who can independently transform complex projects into compelling funding strategies and high quality European proposals.


Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below

Help ambitious organisations secure European funding for high impact innovation projects by combining strategic advice, technical understanding and excellent proposal development.


Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead the development of complex European funding applications under programmes such as Horizon Europe, Innovation Fund, LIFE and CEF.
  • Assess R&D and innovation projects, identify the most appropriate funding opportunities and advise clients on funding strategy.
  • Structure compelling project narratives covering excellence, innovation, impact, implementation and European added value.
  • Interview senior client stakeholders, scientists, engineers and technical experts to extract and challenge the information required for successful proposals.


Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Coordinate the complete proposal development process, including work plans, consortium inputs, budgets, deadlines and quality reviews.
  • Manage client relationships independently and act as a trusted advisor throughout the funding process.

  • Support the development of junior consultants and contribute to business development and the growth of PNO Innovation’s European Grants activities in France.


Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific, engineering, technical, economic or innovation related discipline.
  • Several years of relevant experience in European funding, innovation consulting, R&D project development or a closely related environment.
  • Proven experience with European funding programmes, ideally including Horizon Europe and/or other major programmes such as Innovation Fund, LIFE or CEF. Demonstrated experience writing or leading high quality grant proposals.
  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.


Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Strong ability to understand complex scientific, technological and business concepts and turn them into persuasive narratives.
  • Strong client management, communication and project management skills.
  • Autonomous, rigorous and comfortable managing complex assignments under demanding deadlines.
  • Ability to mentor less experienced consultants and contribute to the development of the team.


Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead major European funding projects with innovative companies and organisations.
  • Work across technologies, sectors and European programmes rather than being limited to a single funding instrument.
  • Join one of Europe’s largest specialist innovation and funding consultancies.
  • Work with an international network of more than 600 colleagues and European funding specialists.


Why us? (What do we offer) 2nd part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Take ownership of client relationships and complex strategic assignments.
  • Contribute to developing junior consultants and strengthening our European Grants practice in France.
  • Benefit from clear opportunities for professional development and increasing responsibility.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package according to experience and seniority.

About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Strategic Account Executive is a field-based position with ownership of an assigned territory (Eastern/Central Europe) focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities. You will have the ability to utilize a robust internal resource model, a broad tech stack, and a global partner directory to position yourself for future success. 

We will consider applicants based in the UK or Netherlands.

You will: 

  • Create, implement, measure and review a personal plan that drives achievement of performance goals aligned to the regional sales strategy. 
  • Position and articulate our value proposition to customers to maximize the business opportunity. 
  • Negotiate and close complex contracts with the support of global partners. 
  • Report on sales activity and forecasts to senior management. 
  • Prepare indicative subscription pricing and customer offers, including reviewing broader opportunities such as training and professional services modules, and guides request for proposal responses. 
  • Provides customer feedback to marketing, customer success, product management, and engineering teams. 
  • Work collaboratively to acquire additional/specialist resources as needed.  

You have: 

  • A demonstrable, successful track record of selling enterprise software solutions in the Eastern/Central European region
  • Proven ability to win net new business.
  • Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota within the market. 
  • Sustainable record of signing strategic and large projects, with long and complex sales cycles. 
  • A combination of experience in selling to both public and private sector accounts is preferred.
  • Established sector-related C level contacts. 
  • Successful record dealing with strategic buyers. 
  • Deep knowledge of the relevant key drivers of change in the industry. 
  • Background working with regional/national/global partners and system integrators.
  • Prior training and experience in value selling and account planning methodologies. 
  • Flexibility to travel to the assigned region as required

 

 

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule
